text: player
Showdown at the Mahjong Table
Kaguyahime
Ron! All Simples, Dora 3 – 7,700 points! I'm still a bit short of a Mangan, but luck seems to be on my side today!
Ichihime
A win, nyaa?! Already?!
Riichi, Ippatsu, Fully Concealed Hand, Dora 3! Haneman, 6,000 points from each of you! Hand over your scoring sticks now!
Asuna
Ugh... she was one step ahead...
Hoho, I was waiting for this tile! Half Flush, Dora 2... Mangan! With the bonus, that's 12,300! That was awfully clumsy of you!
Come on! I only just called Riichi!
Pon!
Oh?
Finally! Ron! Pinfu, All Simples, Pure Double Sequence, Dora 1 – 8,300 points.//nIt's not a lot, but at least this breaks Kaguyahime's streak.
Ohoho... So, you do have some skill. But no matter – the game would be boring otherwise, wouldn't it?
Ohoho... I'm terribly sorry, but I win again.
Tsumo! Riichi, Fully Concealed Hand, Seven Pairs, Dora 4 – 4,000, 8,000! Deary me, I am ever so sorry!
Kirito
Urgh!!
How does Kaguyahime keep winning?!
This isn't the Kaguyahime I know...
Master, Kirito, Asuna! Hang in there, nyaa!!
The last round already? Time sure flies! Looks like this will be over soon.
Incredible... She's won almost every hand since the match started...
That bad rabbit is cheating! I'm sure of it, nyaa! She never wins this much when she plays with me, nyaa!
Ohoho! Jealous of my lucky streak, shorty? What a pity, seems you'll never retake Mahjong Soul Shrine at this rate.
What do we do...? Kirito's already low on points. If this keeps up...
Once our points go negative... there's no coming back, nyaa!
(Stay calm and think... There's definitely something amiss here... What's the difference between the hands she wins and the ones she doesn't...?)
(I suspect Kaguyahime is relying on some sort of trick that lets her see through the tiles. How else could she keep building such insanely good hands?)
(In that case... our only chance of winning is to somehow stop her from drawing tiles!)
Okay... After feeling out the last few rounds, it's pretty clear we can't win like this.
...Got it!
...I trust you!
Oh? Have you decided to stop resisting and go for an all-or-nothing play? Fine by me, I'll show you the meaning of defeat!
Riichi! Ohoho, the end!
Now! Kan!
Nyaa, nyaa?! Calling Kan during the bad rabbit's Riichi? Did you take one too many hits to the head, Kirito?!
Oh? I don't know what you're playing at, but if your defeat wasn't going to be crushing enough already... I'll gladly take the extra Dora.
...This isn't over yet. Asuna, I'm leaving this tile to you!
No problem. If we're going for big hands... then I'm discarding this!
Excellent, and I'll play this West Wind. Asuna!
Okay! Pon! I'll drop this one next!
Huh? H-hold on a minute! What's going on here?! Are you doing this on purpose?!
Then I'll play this tile! Back to you, Kirito!
Skipped? Skipped again?! Let me draw a tile already, you dolts!
Forget about it! Kan! Asuna...!
This hand... I've got it! Riichi!
Master declared Riichi, nyaa! Let's go!
...Okay, you can draw a tile now, Kaguyahime!
Nooo... How is this happening?! Because of that Riichi... I have no choice but to discard this?! Ugh... 5 Man!
That's the one! Ron! Gotcha, Kaguyahime!
Riichi, Ippatsu, Full Flush... Pure Straight, and Dora 2! And it's a huge hit with Sanbaiman, nyaa! That was awesome, Master!
Whaaat?!!
Victory!
Whew... I can finally breathe again...
Kirito, Asuna, and Master make a perfect team! That bad rabbit's done for now, nyaa!
Ohoho...! Who says I lost? You sweet, summer child!
Another dirty trick, you bad rabbit?! You said you'd give the shrine back if you lost, nyaa!
Dirty trick? Deary me! I'd love to call off the monsters, but they simply won't listen – and they insist on crushing every last one of you!
Nyaa?! I knew we shouldn't have trusted you, bad rabbit!
...Is that so? Then I guess we'll just have to let our swords do the talking now!
Leafa
Guys! We'll back you up!
Leafa! Sinon! Are you two alright?!
Sinon
We got held up a bit dealing with small fry... The others will be here any moment. Next up is the boss fight, right?
Exactly... Time to teach this sore loser a lesson she won't soon forget!
I'm joining the fight too, nyaa! I'm gonna give this bad rabbit a good old-fashioned beating!
Alright... Get ready, everyone. Let's finish this!
You lost, Kaguyahime! A deal's a deal – turn everything back to normal!
{var:player_nickname}, forget about defense. From now on, I want you to play aggressively and push your hands. The goal is to land a direct hit on Kaguyahime!
Got it! Pon! {var:player_nickname}, time for you to draw...!
Pon...! That's my final call! {var:player_nickname}...!
